decision.analysis: Residual_hybrid (sol_0002) narrowly leads linear_ridge (sol_0000), while the MLP (sol_0001) loses substantially, suggesting flexible global fitting is unstable and the current lineage is saturated near zero. Explore one independent direct-decision restart and one bounded structural mutation of the strongest parent. Both require positive matched guided-minus-parent mean discounted payoff; an upper 95% confidence bound below zero refutes the proposed direction.
decision.reason: The frontier is shallow and contains no tested program-level direction, so two structurally distinct matched-budget probes are warranted.
decision.success_criterion: For at least one candidate, matched-seed guided-minus-unchanged-parent mean discounted payoff on its exact target slice is greater than 0.
